summary: package options: required name (syntax and names vary by manager), required state (present/absent, others if supported), and use to force a backend, overridable with ansible_package_use.
questions: How do I force the package module to use dnf?
Can I use state latest with the package module?
What variable overrides package manager detection?

answer_card.title: package parameters
answer_card.answer_md:
- `name` (required): name/specifier; syntax depends on manager
- `state` (required): `present`/`absent`; `latest` only if backend supports it
- `use` (auto): force e.g. `dnf`, `apt`. `ansible_package_use` var (2.17+) also overrides detection; the option wins.
